comment: Client build 26404966: (1) the ServerGameDaytimeSync tail (mov r8,[r8+0x2D0]; jmp DaytimeSyncIfChanged) occurs a second time in the client, so the pattern is anchored on the int3 padding before it. (2) Weather: the client's WeatherSystem update (0xaac5a0) is a larger function than the server's (client-side phenomena after the layer update, when the system's mode field is 1; WeatherRemoveInstance indexes instances with stride 0x50 instead of 0x48), so WeatherUpdate and its probe are re-cut; the mode field (+8) and the layer layout (time/weather.layer_*, captured from WeatherUpdateLayers, unchanged) are the same. kiln.time only takes a WeatherSystem of mode 0 that is the server world's own singleton. Evidence: docs/re/client.md.
